$schema.description: Optional JSON Schema reference for editor validation and autocomplete.

listen_address.description: HTTP or HTTPS listen address for the Proxyma service.

scheme.description: Transport scheme served directly by Proxyma.

server_name.description: Optional DNS name or IP address added to generated certificate SANs.

policy_dir.description: Directory containing Proxyma command policy JSON files.

agent_dir.description: Directory containing Proxyma agent JSON files.

user_dir.description: Directory containing Proxyma user JSON files.

task_dir.description: Directory containing persisted task JSON records.

interaction_dir.description: Directory containing persisted human interaction JSON records.

interaction_history_db.description: SQLite database path for the query-optimized interaction history index.

interaction_config_dir.description: Directory containing interaction instance JSON configuration.

user_session_dir.description: Directory containing persisted GUI/API user session JSON records.

credential_token_dir.description: Directory containing persisted one-time activation and password-reset token records.

llm_profile_dir.description: Protected directory containing server-side LLM provider profiles and API keys.

known_hosts_path.description: Proxyma-owned OpenSSH known_hosts file used for SSH host-key verification.

command_timeout.description: Default command execution timeout using Go duration syntax.

interaction_timeout.description: Default timeout for pending human interactions.

output_limit.description: Maximum captured stdout or stderr bytes before truncation.

require_command_approval.description: Whether command tasks require human approval before execution.

user_session_ttl.description: Lifetime for GUI/API user cookie sessions.

user_activation_token_ttl.description: Default lifetime for user activation tokens.

user_activation_token_max_ttl.description: Maximum lifetime an administrator may choose for a user activation token.

debug.description: Enables HTTP request, command preparation, and command execution debug logging.
